android.desc:
Dive deep into the depths of the ocean and embark on a puzzle-solving adventure like no other with Ocean Wood Screw - Nuts Bolts! Enjoy this addictive Nuts And Bolts puzzle game with the challenge of mastering intricate puzzles that will test your logic and problem-solving skills.

Ocean Wood Screw - Nuts Bolts is a Wood Screw Puzzle Game where your goal is to dismantle intricate wooden shapes by removing the correct screws in the right order. Each level introduces new wooden structures, each requiring careful planning and precise moves.

As you progress, the puzzles become increasingly complex, with multiple screws and interconnected shapes. The challenge lies in determining the optimal sequence of screw removal to disassemble the wooden structures without any errors. While the ocean theme offers a calming atmosphere, the puzzles demand sharp thinking and strategic problem-solving skills.

Why You'll Love Wood Screw Puzzle Game:

- Ocean Theme: Enjoy a unique underwater world with calming visuals and sounds.

- Challenging Puzzles: Match nuts and bolts, twist screws, and solve tricky puzzles.

- Power-Ups:

- Unscrew: Instantly remove any screw to aid your progress.
- Undo: Revert to your previous move if you make a mistake.
- Freeze: Gain additional time to strategize your next move.
- Hammer: Break through stubborn wooden shapes with a powerful hammer.

- Relaxing & Fun: Experience soothing gameplay with an engaging challenge.

- Offline Play: Play anytime, even without an internet connection.

How to Play Nuts and Bolts:

- Unscrew Strategically: Carefully remove nuts and bolts to disassemble the wooden structures.
- Plan Ahead: Consider the order of removal to avoid dead ends and solve the puzzle efficiently.
- Utilize Power-Ups: Strategically employ power-ups to overcome challenging levels and progress smoothly

Relax, unwind, and challenge your mind with Ocean Wood Screw - Nuts Bolts!

Download Ocean Wood Screw - Nuts Bolts now and dive into a world of puzzles, powerups, and underwater fun!
